step1.ontologyDesc: LLM analyzes document content and simulation requirements to extract reality seeds and automatically generate an appropriate ontology structure
step1.graphBuildDesc: Based on the generated ontology, documents are auto-chunked and sent to Zep to build a knowledge graph, extracting entities, relations, forming temporal memory and community summaries
step1.buildCompleteDesc: Graph build is complete. Please proceed to the next step for simulation environment setup

step2.simInitDesc: Create a simulation instance and pull simulation world parameter templates
step2.agentGenDesc: Combining context, automatically calls tools to read entities and relations from the knowledge graph, initializes simulation individuals, and assigns them unique behaviors and memories based on reality seeds
step2.simConfigDesc: LLM intelligently sets world time flow rate, recommendation algorithms, each individual's active time periods, posting frequency, event triggers, and other parameters based on simulation requirements and reality seeds
step2.initialActivationDesc: Based on narrative direction, automatically generates initial activation events and hot topics to guide the simulation world's initial state
step2.readyDesc: Simulation environment is ready. You can now start the simulation
step2.roundsAutoDesc: MiroFish auto-plans simulating {hours} hours of reality, each round represents {minutes} minutes of real-time
step2.firstRunTip: If running for the first time, strongly recommend switching to 'Custom mode' to reduce simulation rounds for a quick preview and lower error risk
step2.dimExperienceDesc: Complete behavioral trajectory in this event
step2.dimBehaviorDesc: Experience summary and behavioral style preferences
step2.dimMemoryDesc: Memories formed based on reality seeds

step5.quickSearchDesc: GraphRAG-based instant query interface, optimized indexing for quick extraction of node attributes and discrete facts
